source_of_keywords: coordinator test scope; detailed meanings independently authored using general knowledge before any candidate/profile access

gates.independent_meaning: Blunt short cheek or jaw sidelocks distinguishable from a longer rear hair layer; the authored version also has a straight fringe.
all_of: both short cheek/jaw sections have abrupt blunt lower edges
a separate rear layer visibly continues below the shoulders
the front fringe has a straight eyebrow-level edge
gates.fail_boundary: A single uniform bob, ordinary tapered face framing, or a hidden short/long boundary cannot pass.

gates.independent_meaning: A wearable hair band carrying two decorative triangular ears.
all_of: a headband follows the crown as a separate accessory
two triangular felt ear forms are visible above the crown
the triangles are coherently mounted on the headband
gates.fail_boundary: Biological cat ears, isolated triangular hair tufts, a missing band, or only one readable ear fail.

gates.independent_meaning: A distinct gathered under-skirt worn under the outer skirt, supporting fullness and exposing its own lower hem.
all_of: outer satin skirt and ivory underlayer have separate readable boundaries
ivory gathered or ruffled fabric visibly extends below the outer hem
the underskirt contributes a rounded flared skirt volume
gates.fail_boundary: A decorative trim on one skirt, an ordinary flat lining, or fully concealed layering cannot pass.

gates.independent_meaning: A front closure with a cord repeatedly passing between paired eyelets across opposing garment edges.
all_of: two opposed vertical eyelet rows frame the bodice opening
one cord makes multiple visible X crossings between those rows
cord is visibly connected to the eyelets and closes the opening
the small tied cord bow is readable
gates.fail_boundary: Printed X patterns, disconnected decoration, a single cross, or a concealed thread path cannot pass.

scene_supplemental: night greenhouse and archive are both legible
living plant and preserved sheet occupy a shared local scene
face is guided by observable reference contours without an identity claim
pot support and trolley spacing are physically coherent
